### Crane Company Announces Date for First Quarter 2026 Earnings Release and Teleconference


04/07/2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s21.q4cdn.com/873006999/files/doc_news/Crane-Company-Announces-Date-for-First-Quarter-2026-Earnings-Release-and-Teleconference-2026.pdf)


STAMFORD, Conn.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Crane Company (NYSE: CR) announces the following schedule and teleconference information for its first quarter 2026 earnings release:


- **Earnings Release:** April 27, 2026 after close of market by public distribution and the Crane Company website at[www.craneco.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.craneco.com%2F&esheet=54480675&newsitemid=20260406605236&lan=en-US&anchor=www.craneco.com&index=1&md5=097927cc54d3df3ea6039860e028109f) .
- **Teleconference:** April 28, 2026 at 10:00 AM (Eastern) hosted by Alex Alcala, Executive Vice President & COO (Incoming President & CEO), and Richard A. Maue, Executive Vice President & CFO. The call can be accessed in a listen-only mode via the Company’s website[www.craneco.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.craneco.com&esheet=54480675&newsitemid=20260406605236&lan=en-US&anchor=www.craneco.com&index=2&md5=1101dfa0ce11879f6ffbfae91ac1ef0d) . An accompanying slide presentation will also be available on the Company’s website.
- **Web Replay:** Will be available on the Company’s website shortly after completion of the live call.


**About Crane Company**


Crane Company has delivered innovation and technology-led solutions to its customers since its founding in 1855. Today, Crane is a leading manufacturer of highly engineered components for challenging, mission-critical applications focused on the aerospace, defense, space and process industry end markets. The Company is comprised of two strategic growth platforms, Aerospace & Electronics and Process Flow Technologies. Crane has approximately 8,500 employees in the Americas, Europe, the Middle East, Asia and Australia. For more information, visit[www.craneco.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.craneco.com&esheet=54480675&newsitemid=20260406605236&lan=en-US&anchor=www.craneco.com&index=3&md5=bcce33ac9b0e66964d940fb2cbc43295) .
